description: Generates an AI image on the signed-in aicut account and puts the aicut card in front of the user. It waits for the image server-side for as long as one request safely can (about 24 seconds), so it usually returns the finished image with its `url` directly. WHEN: the user asks for an image. Call `list_models` first if you have not this session (an unpublished combination is rejected). `get_recipe` `starter-image` has the first-image steps. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. AFTER: `succeeded` is finished; `queued` or `processing` was not ready in time: `wait_for_generation` with the returned id and `media: "image"`. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: an image usually finishes in under 90 seconds and can take up to about 4 minutes; this call waits about 24 seconds for it itself. COST: this spends the user's tokens. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's published `aspect_ratios` (for example `9:16`).

images.description: Input image URLs to edit or use as references, on the models that accept them: public https URLs (aicut fetches and stores them) or earlier generations' URLs on this account.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (for example `nano-banana-2`). Use the one the user asked for; never substitute a cheaper model to save them tokens.

prompt.description: What the image should show. The model's `prompt` parameter in `list_models` gives its character limit.

quality.description: Quality tier, on the models that publish a `quality` parameter; higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

resolution.description: One of the model's published options (for example `1k`); higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

wait.description: `false` returns the job id at once (no wait of about 24 seconds): for several images, start them all, then ONE `wait_for_generation` with `ids`. Default true.

name: generate_image
title: Generate an AI image
